title: 462 - The Rocketeer
method: claude-code: written from the transcript, links verified by script

items.description: The episode's game: Bandai's 1991 run and gun platformer based on the Disney movie.

items.description: The 1991 Disney movie the game is based on; Sean watched it to prepare.
